text: Howitzer Leon (Japanese: , Kidō Hakugekihō no Bazu) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Gyanna family and can be found at level 48 inside the Old Quarry in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Honeycomb Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Honeycomb Sweets in the Argentum Trade Guild after completing the Merc Mission Long-Awaited Work.
Hot Ruby Steamed Buns are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Salter Sweets in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Nolha mentions that she was the one who invented them.
How Wars Profit Nopon are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Haskefell Books in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Icicle Marimbas are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Adelno Music in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Hotplate Fry-Ups are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Volty Butchers in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Hobby Knick-Knacks is a shop in . It is run by Tatan and can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Fonsa Myma. It is specialized in Board Games.

Hobby Trappers is a shop in . It is run by Mamanji and can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal's Theosoir. It is specialized in Board Games. The shop is located on top of a building near Praximo Cosmetics, and it can be reached after climbing two ladders.

Hushview Bridge (Japanese: , Monomi no Kakurebashi) is a location in . It is located in the right area of the upper level of the Gormott Province. It is the inside of the tree connecting the Plains of Evening Calm and Nocclia Woods and provides access from the former to Hermit's Hollow. There are no enemies here.

Honey au Lait are Drink Pouch items in . They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Electra. They can be purchased from 12 Brothersisterpon in the Argentum Trade Guild, once all other Brothersisterpon in Alrest have been found and returned to Argentum. One is needed to unlock Fiora's level 3 Nopon Wisdom.
Hungry Feris (Japanese: , Hangurī Ferisu) are enemies in . They are members of the Feris family and can be found at level 32-40 between Garanti Plain and Varnax's Plunge in the Gormott Province.

Hool Arachnos (Japanese: , Heiru Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family and can be found at level 37-44 to the north of (not inside of) Heimos's Crevasse in the Kingdom of Tantal. They can be summoned at level 40-42 by Radliev Pod's art "Emergence". Five must be defeated to unlock Brighid's level 2 "Fire Mastery", Dagas' level 4 Flame Crown and Kaiser Flare, and Praxis' level 3 Geyser Spring on their affinity charts.

High Arrow Tirkin (Japanese: , Haiarō Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 34 - 41 on the Upper Level - Right area of the Gormott Province, particularly at Tirkin Turf or Varnax's Plunge.

High Shield Tirkin (Japanese: , Haishīrudo Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 38-42 on the Upper Level - Right area of the Gormott Province, particularly at the Tirkin Turf or Varnax's Plunge.
Hexaflies are Insect collectibles in . They can be found at the Argentum Trade Guild. In the , Hexaflies can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Hot Oranges are Vegetable collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province, particularly at Kloom Farm near Torigoth.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Hustle Hyacinths are Vegetable collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province, particularly in the Cloud Tank Chamber on the Titan Battleship.
Huust Quadwings (Japanese: , Haido Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 46-48 at the Malignant Gorge on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Ice Headbands (Japanese: , Hyōmon Hachimaki) are accessories in and . They increase the damage of Critical Hits by up to 40%. They are the upgraded version of the Iron Headband. The Optical Headband and Crimson Headband accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
Hezodron Petras are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia, in particular from the two Collection Points just north of the Ancient Wall.
Hollow Lanterns are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree.
Horned Bonytongues are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, in particular at Subterranean Lake Galantia.

Horsecrabs are Fish collectibles in . They can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha, specifically at the Collection Point northwest of the Balquors Ruins Skip Travel Point. One is needed during Souvenirs from Morytha.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Hi-Tech Eyepatches (Japanese: , Denshishiki Kōkinō Gantai) are accessories in . They increase the damage ratio of Arts used to cancel an action by up to 54%. Unlike what the item's description might suggest, the effect will not only apply when cancelling Auto-Attacks, but also when cancelling Blade Switches and other Arts. They are the upgraded version of the Eyepatch and Leader's Eyepatch. The DLC exclusive Noise Dampener accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.
Ice-Lined Coffins are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Canyon of Husks in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.
Icicle Ethers are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Canyon of Husks in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Hypertech Made Easy is a Key Item in . It can be found in a Treasure Trove in an unnamed room southeast of the Sky Bridge in the World Tree, almost due north of Mizar, Elevator 20. Haywire Radclyffe is nearby and a Docel Sentry is in the room with the treasure trove. It unlocks new parts in Poppiswap.

Hexagon Chips are Core Chips in . They can be dropped by Vogar Aspids and Zardl Laias found at the Three-Vein Crossroads in the Kingdom of Tantal and acquired as a quest reward for Bana's Revenge and from Challenge Battle Mode challenges. Hexagon Chips share their appearance with Pentagon Chips, Rhombus Chips, and Tri-Chips. __TOC__

Howardite Chips are Core Chips in . They can be dropped by various enemies primarily in the Land of Morytha alongside several quest-exclusive enemies. Howardite Chips share their appearance with Aubrite Chips, Angrite Chips, and Nakhlite Chips. __TOC__

Horn Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by King Piranhax or awarded upon completion of the DLC quest A Mercenary's Honor. In they can only be dropped by the Golden Monster Sentinel Carpathia. Horn Chips share their appearance with Fang Chips, Scale Chips, and Wing Chips. __TOC__
Hooligan Ignas (Japanese: , Fūrigan Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 29-34 at the Chansagh Wastes in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

|-|Amphoret Pillar = |-|Windpipe Deeps = |-|Xataris Spring = Herridot Laias (Japanese: , Beridoto Raia) are quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Laia family, and are fought three times as groups of two enemies during the quest The Calm and the Storm. The first group is fought at level 55 at Amphoret Pillar in the Kingdom of Tantal, the second one at level 57 at the Windpipe Deeps in the Kingdom of Uraya, and the third one at level 57 at the Xataris Spring in Temperantia.
Humhum is a Nopon in . He can be found at the Sealed Quarry in the Kingdom of Tantal. Humhum gives the quest Partners. He is partners with Mylak.
Iannus is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found at the Torigoth Relay Base in the Gormott Province.
Huw is an NPC in . Huw is a Gormotti who can be found in the Grodd Residential Zone in the Gormott Province.

The Hired Driver (Japanese: , Yatoware no Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive boss in . He is a Driver enemy who can be found at level 40 north of the Indoline Praetorium's Seoris Plaza West Gate during Mellica the Chorister.
Horiz Aspids (Japanese: , Horaizu Asupīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 57-61 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport on the World Tree after Salvaging.
The History of Gormott is a Key Item in . It can be purchased at the Haskefell Books of Torigoth in the Gormott Province for 2,500 G during the quest Lost Kingdom.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Humanoid Hunter (Japanese: , Hyūmanoido Hantā) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases the damage dealt against Humanoids by up to 45%. Humanoid-type enemies belong to the following enemy species: Garlus, Guldo, Igna and Tirkin. All human foes (Ardainian Soldier, Brionac, Indoline Loyalist, Lindwurm, Tantalese Knight) and human Drivers (Ardainian, Gormotti, Urayan, Tornan) are also treated as Humanoid enemies. During the challenge This Year's Heropon, all Nopon are Humanoids (except for the potato Tatsu, which is an Aquatic Skeeter). Blades belong to the Blade-type, and are generally not affected by this effect. The Skill RAM/Upgrade v

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Hunter's Chemistry (Japanese: , Sensei Kizuna) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM / Upgrade in and . It increases the Affinity of the entire party by up to 250 at the start of the battle, when starting with initiative. Initiative is obtained when the player starts the battle with the weapon unsheathed or when luring an enemy. Most barrier erecting story or quest battles will also provide initiative to the player. This effect will uniquely apply even when the equipped Blade is not engaged on the field, and stacks with all Hunter's Chemistries equipped to Blades on the active party. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Po

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Ice Def Up (Japanese: , Kōri Zokusei Damēji Genshō) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It reduces the damage received from Ice elemental attacks by up to 35%. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Ice Reflect (Japanese: , Kōri Zokusei Hansha Shīrudo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . Every time the user blocks an Ice elemental attack, this equipment nullifies the damage taken and reflects it back to the enemy. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
The Hideout Key is a Key Item in . It is needed to complete the quest We Meet Again. It is obtained by defeating the two Brionac Lyman in Alba Cavanich during the quest.

Icarus Butchers is a shop in . It can be found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. It is run by Severtine and is specialized in Meats. None of its items are exclusive to Icarus Butchers, and can be found at other shops in Alrest.
The Hundred Devil Sword is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 40 Photon Saber received as a reward for The Duel (Part IV) if route A is chosen.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Ice Absorb (Japanese: , Kōri Zokusei Kyūshū Shīrudo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . Every time the user blocks an Ice elemental attack, this equipment nullifies the damage taken and converts it into HP restoration. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

The Hyacinth Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Bumper Crop. It enables the purchase of Boiled Hustle Hyacinth from the Sadecott Groceries shop at Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Hotplate Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Bumper Crop. It enables the purchase of Hotplate Fry-Up from the Volty Butchers shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Hot Ruby Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Cold Storage. It enables the purchase of Hot Ruby Steamed Bun from the Salter Sweets shop at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Icicle Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission White and Cold. It enables the purchase of Icicle Marimba from the Adelno Music shop in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Ice Cabbage Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Weathered Ship. It enables the purchase of Vinaigrette Ice Cabbage from the Lectica Vegetables shop at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
The Howl Sentries are two Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Sentries that are fought at level 56 at the Data Processing Room in the World Tree during Limits of Awareness.

Holy Choir is a Merc Mission in , It can be received in the Indoline Praetorium during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals reaches Level 9. After Chapter 8, it can also be received automatically from the Leftherian Archipelago; if the mission was already unlocked in Indol before that point, it will be transferred to Leftheria. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fire Mastery" and "Wind Mastery" Field Skills. It increases Ursula's fanbase by a large amount. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.
Hurricane Punch (Japanese: , Harikēnsutorēto, Lit. "Hurricane Straight") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. This art recycles Rex's Mach Straight Punch.

Hurricane Dropkick (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).

The Himahistone is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having him appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point near the Twin Trunks Hill in the Gormott Province.
Hidden Landmarks are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Market of Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

Highspear Tirkin (Japanese: , Kamiyari Tākin) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family that are fought at level 62 during the Challenge Battle Sacred Wood. They are summoned by the Regodos Totem alongside Highbow Tirkin, Highpipe Tirkin, and Highshield Tirkin. This enemy drops no items.

Highbow Tirkin (Japanese: , Kamiyumi Tākin) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 60 when summoned by the Regodos Totem during the Challenge Battle Sacred Wood. This enemy drops no items.

Highpipe Tirkin (Japanese: , Kamifue Tākin) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family fought at level 62 upon being summoned by the Regodos Totem during the Challenge Battle Sacred Wood. This enemy drops no items.

Hunting Volffs (Japanese: , Hantingu Vorufu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Volff family fought at level 95 during the third wave of the Challenge Battle Reinventing the Gogol. This enemy drops no items.

Hunting Rhoguls (Japanese: , Hantingu Rōguru) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and two are fought at level 96 during the fourth wave of the Challenge Battle Reinventing the Gogol. This enemy drops no items.

Humanoid Alliance is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Elma's level 5 "Overdrive" Battle Skill. This challenge takes place on the hill west of the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia.
Hufford is an Ardainian in . He can be found in the Cargo Transportation Zone of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Hurricane Anise (Japanese: , Senpūten Anāshu) is one of the Golden Monsters in . It is a Unique Monster, and can be found at level 100 at the Pedestal of Stargazing in the Tornan Titan Interior. It can be fought after buying Anise's Location from the Nopon Halfsage. At level 100, Hurricane Anise is the highest level enemy in .

The Holy Gate of Altana (Japanese: , Arutana Daiseimon) is a landmark in . It is located in the southernmost area of the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna, directly up the Sacred Staircase from the Loftin Nature Preserve. Once open it leads into the Tornan Titan Interior. There is a Campsite and a Treasure Trove here, but no enemies.
The Hidden Hunting Camp (Japanese: , Karyūdo no Kakure Kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is a campsite located in the northwestern area of Gormott, at Seigle Fell. There are no enemies here.

The Hoary Weald Camp (Japanese: , Koshinrin no Kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is a campsite located on the eastern side of the raised northern section of Gormott, north of the Hoary Weald. There are two old machines here, and on a platform almost directly above the camp there is a Treasure Trove and the Unique Monster Ravine Bunnit. Melosian Honey can be collected from a cave just northwest from here, within which there are another two Treasure Troves.

The Hoary Weald (Japanese: , Shin'ō no Koshinrin) is a location in . It is a large open area located in the northeastern area of Gormott, above Nebley Wind Cave and south of the Hoary Weald Camp. The Hoary Wield would be known 500 years later as the Nocclia Woods. The Nocclia Timber Site had not yet been established.
Homegrown Inventor is a quest in . It can be received from Marcus in the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco the capital of the Kingdom of Torna.

The Hewli Gogol (Japanese: , Hyūri Gogōru) is a Quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Gogol family and can be found at level 35 in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna, in the eastern Dannagh Desert. It must be defeated during An Oasis for All. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , the Hewli Gogol drops no items, only gold.
Hungry for More is a quest in . It can be received from Omnom in the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco, the capital of the Kingdom of Torna.
Hubbie Takes a Hike is a quest in . It can be received from Chica in the Formide Shopping Ward in the Kingdom of Torna.
Hollow Charms are Charms in . They can be created by Lora at Campsites.
Hopeful Perfumes are Fragrance items in . They can be created by Brighid at Campsites.
Hyber Meatball Stews are Veggie Pouch Items in . They can be crafted by Aegaeon at Campsites.
Hustle Marinades are Veggie Pouch Items in . They can be crafted by Aegaeon at Campsites.
Horned Sculpins are Fish collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.

Hi-vis Wires are Mechanical collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna, in particular near Aletta: Militia Garrison, in an old machine slightly south east of the landmark. A Silver Seeker is required to collect this item.
Hugo's Gold Detector is a Key Item in . It is built during The Secret of Dannagh for the purpose of finding gold in the Dannagh Desert.
Highscreeb Quadwings (Japanese: , Haisukurība Kurōdo) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 39-41 on Hoary Weald Camp in Gormott at night.
Hungry Snake (Japanese: ) is one of Lora's Vanguard Arts in . When used, Lora does a snake-like spin kick.
Huracán (Japanese: , Urakan) is one of Minoth's Vanguard Arts in .
Hilo (Japanese: , Hīro) is one of Minoth's Rear Guard Arts in .
Hyber Weapons is a shop in . It is run by a Nopon peddler and can be found at Hyber Village in the Kingdom of Torna. It is specialized in Core Chips.

High Leaves (Japanese: , Hai Rīfu) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to their description, they are bitter-tasting grey leaves, and they are highly effective as a fertiliser. Five are needed for New Way of Life.
Hunting Help (Japanese: , Kari no Tetsudai) is a quest in . It can be received from Haemlin at Companions' Cape on Bionis' Shoulder, or later at the Gran Dell Ramparts.
Humble Beginnings is a Time Attack challenge in . It can be received from Nopon Archsage. The challenge battle is located at Mechon Wreckage Site.

Highlightnings (Japanese: , Hairaitoningu) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to the description, they were carefully named by Melia. Their light banishes the darkness, bringing hope.
Highborn Alexandra (Japanese: , Kōkina Arekisandora) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Eks family, and can be found at level 64 at Cinnabar Plateau on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Hook, Line and Sinker (Japanese: , Sakana Hokaku Sakusen) is a quest in . It can be received from Vredda at the Grand Arch in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder.
The Hope Way (Ruined) (Japanese: , Kibō no Renrakutsūro-ato) is a location in . It is located in Alcamoth.
High Entia Feathers are Key Items in . Five are required for Drydry Entia in Alcamoth.
Hyber Accessories is a shop in . It is run by a Nopon peddler and can be found at Hyber Village in the Kingdom of Torna. It is specialized in Accessories.
Hundred-Year Wave (Japanese: , Lit. "Hidden Blade: Hundred-Year Wave") is Aegaeon's Level III Blade Special in .
Ice Revolution (Japanese: , Hyōran, "Ice Disruption") is Jin's Level III Blade Special in .
Hidden Emotion (Japanese: , Hido~un'emōshon) is Kasandra's Level II Blade Special in .
Ice Slash (Japanese: , Vaisusurasshu, Lit. "Weiss Slash") is Theory's Level I Blade Special in .
Husk Shooters are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are gunberries wielded by Kino.
Husk Chuckers are weapons in . They are gunberries wielded by Kino.

Hugo's Machine-tinkering is a skill in , with which Hugo can prepare Key Items from various Collectibles at campsites that grant permanent passive effects to the party, similar to Store Deeds in the main game. These recipes and items are unique to Hugo and cannot be obtained any other way. Recipes can be unlocked by receiving them as rewards for certain Quests.

High Maktha Wildwood (Japanese: , Morukuna Daishinrin: Jōsō) is an Area in , located in the Pentelas Region. It is a dense forest with huge plants growing thickly and famously sublime fruits. The remains of the Land of Morytha and parts of Makna Forest make up the forest. Colony Tau is located here.
The Homecoming Ceremony (Japanese: , Seijin no gi, Coming-of-age Ceremony) is a plot element in .

The Hillside Ferronis Hulk (Japanese: , Kyūryō no Kuchita Tetsukyoshin) is a Rest Spot in , located on Viliera Hill in Millick Meadows. This Ferronis Hulk becomes usable after completing The Hillside Hulk, and requires 1 Ether Cylinder to reboot. The Hilltop Caravan is located here.
The Hidden Freshwater Inlet (Japanese: , Seiryū no Kakushi Irie) is a Secret Area in , located at the Great Cotte Falls. The Unique Monster Massive Georges is located here.

Househunter Carly (Japanese: , Yadosagashi no Kārī) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 21 near Forward Post Camp in Alfeto Valley. The Bubble Cloud Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Hovering Reef 2 Camp (Japanese: , Daini Fuyū Ganshō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located on Hovering Reef 2 of the Syra Hovering Reefs.
The Hull Maintenance Block (Japanese: , Gaikaku Seibu Kukaku) is a Location in . It is located on the third floor of Keves Castle.
The Hidden Stash (Japanese: , Kakushi Chozōko) is a Landmark in . It is located at the end of Torus Hollow on Elaice Highway, past Cadion Cliffside. It is Colony Iota's supply storage.

The Hidden Weapon Lab (Japanese: , Kakusareta Heiki Kenkyūshitsu) is a Location in . It is located within the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region. This location becomes accessible during the Ascension Quest Payback for Treason.
Hykt's Cove (Japanese: , Hikuto no Irie) is a Location in . It is located in Erythia Sea. The Inlet Camp is located here.
The Holy Lid (Japanese: , Seibuta no Kanchō, lit: Crown of the Sacred Lid) is a Secret Area in , located in Fort O'Virbus on the Syra Hovering Reefs.

Hornbow Dante (Japanese: , Dokaku no Dantesu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Balgas family, and can be found at level 55 near Ekdaso Verge on the Syra Hovering Reefs. The Dual-Horn Pressure Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Hictern's Cleft (Japanese: , Hikkutan no Sakeme) is a Location in . It is located on Elaice Highway in the Fornis Region, west of Singbreeze Funnel.
I'm a Mechanic (Japanese: , Boku wa Mekanikku) is an Ascension Quest in , dedicated to Valdi.
Horrishes are a family of enemies in . They appear exclusively in Origin.
Honey Lilies are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Hitter Bunnits are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 48-49 on Tsang Road on Captocorn Peak.
Hexa-Stabilizers are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Heyday Poplars are Wood Collectible items in and . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region in . They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation. They can be found on The Ragmos Desolation in . Four are needed for The Ragmos Desolation Collectopaedia.
Honey Plums are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator after First Day of Prison has been completed.
Honking Shrubs are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Hiero Loops are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Origin. They can also be produced from the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator after Origin is reached for the first time.

Hovering Reef 0 (Japanese: , Dairei Fuyū Ganshō) is a Location in . It is located at the Syra Hovering Reefs in the Keves Castle Region. It becomes accessible during A Deep-Seated Scar, and can be reached by rope sliding from Hovering Reef 5. It was the site used for executions by the hand of Consul V when Kevesi soldiers had finished their 10th term. It became abandoned when M lied to the Consuls that Z preferred the soldiers to pass away naturally rather than be executed.
Hyadet Enpedias are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Enpedia family, and can be found at level 70-71 at Defense Tower #1 and Defense Tower #3 in the Origin Interior.
Hunter Ansels are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 52-53 in Farlaine Underpass in Erythia Sea.
Hildemarie (Japanese: , Himari) is a NPC in . She is a soldier from Colony Mu.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Hyper Protectors are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Peak Caravan and Castle Commissary. The legendary variant can be obtained from Diabolical Rindolph. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Stronghammer Dorga.
The Hilltop Caravan is a shop in . It is located at the Hillside Ferronis Hulk in Millick Meadows after completing The Hillside Hulk.

Hexagonal Orig. Shards are Key Items in . They are Origin Shards. They are used to Upgrade Blades and enhance Crafted Accessories. They can be purchased for 9,000 red Noponstones at the Prize X-change Red, and 1,800 blue Noponstones at the Prize X-change Blue.

The Homecomers' Key is a Key Item in . It is obtained by completing the quest The Key to a New Home. This key can be used to open the locked room in the Lost Numbers Dormitory, which contains a Thank-You Card inside.
Hybro Crustips are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 45-46 on the Urayan Trail in the Pentelas Region.
Highwind Moramoras are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Moramora family, and can be found at level 57 at Cape Arcaphor in the Erythia Sea.
Hugya Aspars are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family, and can be found at level 63 on Lavi Sandbar in Erythia Sea.
Honorine (Japanese: , Eishi) is an NPC in who can be found in Colony Tau.
Hexen (Japanese: ) is a NPC in who can be found in Colony 11.

Hunter Volffs (Japanese: , Hantā Vorufu) are four Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Volff family, and are fought at level 17 at the Metamural Garden in the Eagus Wilderness during No Want of Courage.

Hungry Anloods (Japanese: , Hangurī Haindo) are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family, and are fought at level 34 at the Colony Tau Entrance in High Maktha Wildwood during The Harvest.
Hungry Skwarors are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Skwaror family, and are fought at level 34 at the Colony Tau Entrance in High Maktha Wildwood during The Harvest.
Hungry Quadwings are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and are fought at level 34 at the Colony Tau Entrance in High Maktha Wildwood during The Harvest.
Hornet (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Strategos class. Hornet is unlocked as a Master Art upon reaching Rank 10 with the class.
Hyper Reload (Japanese: , Haipārirōdo) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Advanced Cooldown that can only be used by Valdi.
Hyper Dropkick is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Destructive Charge that can only be used by Ghondor.
Hot Cuisine (Japanese: , Wakuwaku kukkingu) is a Battle Art in . It is an Art used only by Riku & Manana. The Art inflicts the Accuracy Down debuff.

Hydra Gas is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Demonic Krenolur while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Hypno-Light is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Heretical Saurow while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Horn Dance is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Perspicacious Oldar while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Hypnotism (Japanese: , Saiminjutsu) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Profound Hodzuki while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

The Humongous Nopon Doll is an Accessory in and . In , it is received from the Nopon Archsage after clearing all Challenge Battles with S Rank only in New Game +, replacing the Archsage's Flower Fan as the reward if the player has already acquired the Archsage's Flower Fan in a prior playthrough. In , it is obtained as a reward for completing Nopon Medals Needed.

The Hidden Windy Cave (Japanese: , Kazanari no Kakushi Dōkutsu) is a location in , located north of Raguel Bridge - North on The Ragmos Desolation. It is likely the remains of the Windy Cave from Bionis' Leg.

Hyzen is an NPC in . He is a former Keves soldier with High Entia traits who now works alongside Saomi as part of the Liberators. He can be found around Colony 9 in Yesterdale. His Community is gained when talking to him by talking to him after completing Snow Man's Treasure.

High Agnus Emblems are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Agnian Standards, and can be found at level 27 at the Lumos Pillar Remnants and the Lumos Garrison on The Ragmos Desolation. They drop rare Emblem Adornments.
High Keves Emblems are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Kevesi Standards, and can be found at level 39 at the Gelgemos Garrison on The Ragmos Desolation. They drop rare Emblem Adornments.
Hilltop Chegwin (Japanese: , Kyūryō no Shengurin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 13 by Zalmor's Falls on the Aurora Shelf.
Hoovehoove's Amulet - Gold is a Key Item in . It is received from Bobobi during Nopon Medals Needed.
Hoovehoove's Amulet - Silver is a Key Item in . It is received from Bobobi during Nopon Medals Needed.

Hostile Colony (Dynamic) is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track fourteen of disc two on the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track fourteen of disc thirteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. Hostile Colony is an instrumental version of this track, and when the party engages an enemy in battle when "Hostile Colony (Dyanmic)" is the current area theme, the song will transition into "Hostile Colony". This song plays as the area theme during the following circumstances: * From Colony 9's ambush on Noah, Lanz, and Eunie to Mio, Sena, and Taion's return to the Gura Flava Lowlands during Chapter 1. * From when the party tries to escape from Colony 4's attac

Hope for the Future is a track from and , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track fifteen of disc eight from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track fifteen of disc nineteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This track plays during the following moments in : * When Ghondor gives Noah the key to the Cloudkeep. * When Nia explains the origins of Ouroboros and the Sword of the End. * The final part of the credits. This track plays during the following moments in : * Shulk, A, and Riku's conversation at the Valak Peak Camp. * Shulk and Rex granting Nikol and Glimmer their life force before Shulk, Rex, and A become the new avatars of Origin.

Homecoming is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track thirteen of disc six from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track thirteen of disc seventeen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during Mio's Homecoming Ceremony in Agnus Castle.

The High Ether Crystal is a Key Item in . It is an ether crystal of high concentration that is found in the Zekr Marga Quarry on the Bionis' Shoulder during the Story Quest The Quest for High Ether. It is used to upgrade Shulk's Monado Replica EX into the Monado Replica EX+ in order to make the Fog King vulnerable.
Hraesvelg Robus is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in . It is a Human-Made Skell that is fought at level 36 at the Bedrock Hold Approach in Primordia during Thinking Makes It So.

The Hraesvelg Lord is a Skell in . It is the level 60 version of the Hraesvelg skell and becomes available after completing Thinking Makes It So. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.
Howling Soul is one of Al's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing A Hero's Trial.

High Tier Hoods II are light head armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Melia for the first time on the Battle Race course Twilight Speedway. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 5300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Hoods I are light head armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2000 for the first time with Melia in the Score Attack course Caterpile Circuit. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Coats II are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Melia for the first time on the Battle Race course Midnight Forest. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 8800 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Coats I are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2200 for the first time with Melia in the Score Attack course Jungle Rumble. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 5900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Boots II are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Melia for the first time on the Battle Race course Colony 9 Wild Ride. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 6300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Boots I are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2800 for the first time with Melia in the Score Attack course Rural Road. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4200 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Arms I are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2400 for the first time with Melia in the Score Attack course Alcamoth Orbital. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Arms II are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Melia for the first time on the Battle Race course Alcamoth at Dawn. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3400 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Trunks II are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Melia for the first time on the Battle Race course Blizzard Rally. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 6900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

High Tier Trunks I are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2600 for the first time with Melia in the Score Attack course Valak Slalom. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4600 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Melia.

The Hilal Stronghold Key was an Important Item in . It was intended to be obtained from a Tower Marnuck during Reporting for Duty where the Hilal Stronghold must be investigated, however the building is finally not locked.

Hiroyuki Sawano (Japanese: , Sawano Hiroyuki) is a composer for TV series (both live-action and animated) and movies. He first became famous for the soundtrack of the live-action adaption of Team Medical Dragon. The soundtrack of is the first soundtrack he has composed for a video game. He has been active since 2006.
Hyper-Rails are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Spine-Cannon/E-Bubble/B-Bomb types Qmoevas or female Milsaadi.

Igna Hide Jackets (Japanese: , Igūna-zoku no Kawa Seihin) are rare material items in . They can only be dropped by Ignas in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, they are superior durable leather products that look great coated in grease. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased at Time Attack from the Nopon Archsage for 1,400 Noponstones.

This quest will expire after the decision to move to Colony 6, and if Spirits Raised is completed instead. Imaginations Tempered (Japanese: , Kimi ga Okuru Monogatari, A Story for You) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Matryona in the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. As with all the quests in the Refugee Camp, it will expire after the residents migrate to Colony 6. This quest and Spirits Raised are mutually exclusive.

It's All in the Mind (Japanese: , Yamai wa Kikara) is a quest in . It can be received from Zazadan in the Nopon Refuge in Satorl Marsh. It is the fourth in a series of five quests that can be received from Zazadan. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.
Iron Pikes (Japanese: , Aianpaiku) are weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be traded for with various NPCs or bought from a shop in Colony 9.
Infantry Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought from the shop at the Refugee Camp for 3,600 G.

Imperial Ceremony Offerings (Japanese: , Kōzoku no Gi no Junbi) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Scarlen at the Oath Sanctuary at Satorl Marsh after The Imperial Ceremony has been accepted. It is required to complete The Imperial Ceremony.

The Imperial Palace (Japanese: 皇宮, Kōgū) is a landmark in . It is located on the second floor of Alcamoth. It is directly east of the entrance to Alcamoth, and it is the entrance to the palace in which many of the guards and nobles are found.
Iron Armour is medium torso armour in . It can be dropped by Aqua Nebulae in Satorl Marsh. It is made with iron ore from Satorl Marsh.
Infantry Attire is light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can only be obtained from the Supply Convoy Shop at Sword Valley.
Iron Gear (Japanese: , Aian Gia) is medium head armour in . It is made from iron ore from Satorl Marsh
Inferno Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Iron Gauntlets are medium arms armour in . They are made with iron ore from Satorl Marsh.
Iron Leggings are medium legs armour in . They are made with iron from Satorl Marsh. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing Satata's Younger Brother.

The Igna Territory (Japanese: , Igūna no Ryōchi) is a location in . It is located southwest of the Glowing Obelisk. Several drops, such as Igna Stone Pots, Large Igna Crystals, Swep Gear, Swep Leggings, Shoddy Weapons, Igna Hide Jackets, and Tank Guarders can be obtained from the Ignas residing here.

Igna Stone Pots are rare materials in . They can be dropped by a wide variety of Ignas in Satorl Marsh and traded for in Colony 6 and Satorl Marsh. According to their description, they are used for cooking when out hunting, making them versatile and convenient. Three are needed for Nopon Determination.

]] Ignas (Japanese: , Igūna) are a reptilian family of bipedal enemies in the . Ignas are similar in appearance and may be related to Kromars and Merignas. They all have the same appearance, but different equipment, in , and vary in looks in , where Ignas may be red or green and may have an orange frill on their head and neck, and in .
Iron Boots are medium feet armour in . They are made with iron ore from Satorl Marsh.

Immovable Gonzalez (Japanese: , Fudō no Gonzaresu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 90 in Spiral Valley after the battle with the Tentacled Mechon and Mysterious Face. It can drop Gogol Horns, which are required for A Token of Friendship and Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Iron Bunnivs (Japanese: , Aian Banīvu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Bunniv family. They can be found in Tephra Cave in the passages near the Caterpile Nest. They drop Heavy Bunniv Iron, two pieces of which are needed to complete the quest Education-Crazy Suzanna.

Impenetrable Redrob (Japanese: , Teppeki no Reddorobu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Krabble family that uses Mechon armour as a shell. It can be found on the south side of Hazzai Cape in Colony 9 at night. It can drop Krabble Artwork, which is required for Désirée's Apology.

Ingredients For A Brew (Japanese: , Sakezukuri no Zairyō) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Kofuko near the armour shop at the Central Plaza in Frontier Village, after accepting Sweet Seduction.

Investigating Satorl (Japanese: , Zatōru no Chōsa) is a quest in . It can be received from Miriall in the Ether Plant at Eryth Sea, only if the party has not completed Talia's Research, has accepted The Missing Boy, and has cleared Mechonis Core. This quest and Talia's Research Alcamoth quest are mutually exclusive. By completing either this quest or Talia's Research, the party will have access to the next quest, Ancient High Entia Mystery, that will unlock Melia's fifth skill branch. Talia will have a full new trade at Satorl Marsh only during this quest (or during Talia's Research).

Iron Cutlasses (Japanese: , Gantettō) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are swords wielded by Dunban. They can be aquired by purchasing them at the Melfica Road Shop in Alcamoth for 16,200 G or by trading with Atael who can be found in Alcamoth.
The Ignis Rifle (Japanese: , Igunisuraifuru) is an Ether Rifle in Xenoblade Chronicles, and can be wielded by Sharla. It can only be obtained from one shop.
Ironwall Gnashers (Japanese: , Teppeki no Tsukutsuku) are weapons in . They are one type of Riki's biters, and can be dropped by Eryth Hilns and Hover Astas.
Infinity (Japanese: , Infiniti) are Unique weapons in . They are twin blades wielded by Fiora.

※ After this quest is completed, Gerugu may offer another quest. See Legend of Mythical Empress. It Definitely Exist! (Japanese: , Zettai Iru) is a quest in . It can be received from Pachipa in the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment.

Inlet Beach (Japanese: , Irie no Sunahama) is a landmark in . It is located on the lower level of the Fallen Arm, and is where Dunban, Riki and Melia are found after falling from Galahad Fortress. The three of them spend the night here together following the event. There is a Heart-to-Heart located here - "Camping Spot" (Melia and Riki, purple affinity) - and no enemies other than Piranhax in the water.

The Interior Landing Site (Japanese: , Tainai Teihaku-sho) is a landmark in . It is located within the First Lung in the Bionis' Interior, and is the location of Junks whilst in the Interior. Discovery of this landmark causes Vanea's Replica Monado quests to become available. In , a Time Attack portal can be found here.

The Imperial Treasury (Japanese: , Ōke no Hōmotsuko) is a location in . It is located in the second basement floor of the High Entia Tomb. To gain access inside the treasury, the High Entia Emblem is needed to unlock the seal. It can be obtained by completing The Imperial Ceremony and Imperial Ceremony Offerings. The door can be found by climbing down the walls inside the Hall of Trials on the second basement floor of the tomb. The treasure consists of Grace Gloves, Grace Shoes, and a Debuff Resist VI gem.
Initial Tension (Japanese: , Battō Tenshon) is a Gem in that increases the Tension level at the start of a battle. __TOC__

Indomitable Daulton (Japanese: , Fukutsu no Dōruton) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 85 at Soter Ruins, just south of the Oath Sanctuary in Satorl Marsh. A group of Baelfael Gogols appear alongside it. The party must defeat the Indomitable Daulton to complete Nic's Final Test which is received from Nopo'rikh in Colony 6. It can drop the Gogol Horns needed for A Token of Friendship and Colony 6 Reconstruction.

The Imperial Radiant is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the four radiants that must be collected for Imperial Ceremony Offerings, and can only be acquired while this quest is active. It is obtained from within the Ceremony Hall in the High Entia Tomb.
The Inscription Rubbing is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is required for The Path of Bafalgar. It can be obtained by examining the inscription in the Prayer Room in the Bafalgar Tomb.

Inja Telethia (Japanese: , Inja Tereshia) are two story exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Phoenix-type members of the Telethia family, and can be found at level 68 in Colony 6 at Main Entrance. Inja Telethia only appear during a story event. They are fought along with a Sero Telethia during the first round of the related battle.

Iron Krabble Shells are rare materials in . They can be dropped by one species of Krabble in Colony 9, and can be traded for with Mefimefi if she has not moved to Colony 6 or if Perrine has moved over her. According to their description, they are portable iron dwellings that leave one wondering if only all homes were as convenient as them. Two of them are needed for The Plan - The Night Before.

In Pursuit of Love (Japanese: , Koibitosagashi) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Rosemary near the shop by the Main Entrance, up a staircase, in Colony 6. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment. After completing this quest, The Melody of Happiness or Dream of a Poet will be triggered. The prerequisites of this quest are the Colony 6 affinity that is at ☆1.5, and that Rosemary must be in Colony 6, and it can be accepted as soon as the player finds her there; however, the quest cannot be completed until Nic, Peppino, Yura, and Pokapoka have all been invited to Colony 6, and doing so requires a Housing Level of 5.

Instant Death is a status in . It inflicts damage equal to the target's maximum HP, thereby killing or incapacitating the target. Enemies killed by Instant Death from either Reflection or self infliction do not drop Treasure Chests. Protection from this status can be obtained by using Sharla's Cure Bullet or Cure Round arts, or Divine Protect or Debuff Resist gems. Sharla's Shield Bullet does not give complete protection but can reduce the damage, leaving the target with HP up to equal to the amount of protection provided by the Shield, which prevents an immediate Knockout from Instant Death. The Instant Death status cannot bypass the effect of an Unbeatable Gem, and it is still possible to

Iron Antol Fibres are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from the Daughter Empress on Bionis' Leg and Makna Antols in Makna Forest or traded for in Frontier Village with Bana and Pokapoka if he has not moved to Colony 6. According to their description, they are threads as tough as steel even though they do not make a good skipping rope.
Ishmael Hills (Japanese: , Ishumeru Hiruzu) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Residential District in New Los Angeles, south of the Cathedral.

The Items from Ewan are a Key Item in . They are received from Ewan during A Dash of Colour and must be delivered to Matryona. They consist of a letter of apology to Matryona and paints made from Sour Gooseberries for illustrating the Picture Book that they are making for Pama.

Interceptors (Japanese: , Intāseputā) is a division within BLADE. They are in charge of creature subjugation. They are also bodyguards for the survey teams and rescue New Los Angeles citizens. Interceptors receive increased Division Points from defeating enemies and completing missions. Receiving division support from Interceptors grants Ranged Master, which increases damage dealt by ranged weapons.
Infuriate is a Debuff Battle Art in Xenoblade Chronicles X, and one of Cross' five signature arts.

Irregular Bound (イレギュラーバウンド) is a Field Track in Xenoblade Chronicles, composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 19 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard whenever an enemy initiates a battle against the party in the Mechonis areas of the game: Galahad Fortress, Fallen Arm, Mechonis Field, Central Factory, and Agniratha. It may also be heard in Sword Valley after the party has already reached Galahad Fortress. This theme is meant to incite the player to either fight or escape.

Inferno is a Medium Type Skell unit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Inferno is one of the Skells developed and manufactured by BLADE in New Los Angeles. It is the main model for general mass production. The Inferno vehicle is a sort of futuristic armed van. The level 60 upgrade of this Skell is the Inferno Skydon.

In the Refugee Camp (alternatively known simply as Refugee Camp; 脱出艇キャンプ, Escape Boat Camp) is a Field Track in Xenoblade Chronicles, composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 9 of disc 3 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard when the party is at the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. Despite the fact that the surrounding area has different music depending on whether it is day or night, the music associated with this area will stay the same regardless of the time of day.

Intrigue (陰謀) is an Event Track in and , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 14 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track five of disc three from the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This music is an enigmatic, onimous theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * Shulk and Reyn spotted by a Mechon unit as they emerge from Tephra Cave * Shulk and Reyn find an abandoned buggy on Gaur Plain * Melia ponders Shulk and the Monado as the party reaches the Decayed Forest * Lorithia's research in the Telethia Laboratory * Yumea and Tyrea plot against Melia as she enters Alcamoth * Kallian sees Yu

In the forest is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano, with original lyrics and vocals provided by mpi. It is track 16 of disc two from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack.

The Intimidator Simius (Japanese: , Shaddā Shimiusu, Shudder Simius) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Simius and can be found at level 14 at North Janpath Plain in Primordia. Defeating it is required to complete the Affinity Mission We Were Soldiers given by Vandham at the BLADE Barracks in New Los Angeles.
The Industrial District (Japanese: , Kōgyō Eria) is a region in . It is located in New Los Angeles. The West Gate of New Los Angeles is located in this district.

Iron Femina Suids (Japanese: , Aian Femina Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and can be found at level 11-18 in Primordia's La Mancha. Ten must be defeated using the Hyde Dyads in order to complete That's In-Credible!.

Iron Suids (Japanese: , Aian Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and can be found at level 11-18 in Primordia south of Janpath Lake. They can drop the Suid Fillet needed for Suid Sirloin.
Indigo Turbas (Japanese: , Indigo Kurekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Turba family, and can be found at level 19-20, at Breakwater Narrow in Noctilum.
The Integrated Production Plant (Japanese: , Sōgō Seisan Puranto) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Industrial District, southwest of the Central Industrial District.
Indigen Investigation is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a golden mortifole feathers request from a Biologist and the primary destination is Noctilum.
Iron Ciniculas (Japanese: , Aian Vasaruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cinicula family, and can be found at level 47-48 at Middle Hushflood in Noctilum.

Iolite Forfexes (Japanese: , Aioraito Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 7-10 on the southern shore of Seabird's Beak in Sylvalum.
Iron Simius (Japanese: , Aian Shimiusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Simius family, and can be found at level 37-39 at East Janpath Plain in Primordia.

Innocent Ovis (Japanese: , Inosento Owisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ovis family, and can be found at level 21-28 in Oblivia, east of FN Site 302 or south of FN Site 316.
Insidias (Japanese: , Parako) are bipedal reptilian-like creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look like small Dilophosaurids.
Ictuses (Japanese: , Manda) are insect-like creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look like big mantises with huge blade-like arms. They can be found in Primordia, Oblivia, Sylvalum, and Cauldros

Impact Galdr (Japanese: , Inpakuto Garudora) are Story Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's Skells type, and can be found at level 27 at the NLA Primary Defense Line in Primordia during Chapter 8, when the Ganglion attack the East Gate of New Los Angeles. Two of them must be defeated in the third wave of Ganglion attacks. Both Impact Galdr are black, but one is equipped with titan missiles and the other with tornado claws.

Inisae (Japanese: , Inisae) is a Ma-non NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. She will be near the BLADE Barracks in the Administrative District during the day, along with Sarona, after Close Encounters.
Impish Mephites (Japanese: , Inpisu Mepitesu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mephite family, and can be found at level 22-24 on Aaroy Plain in Oblivia.
Isobe (Japanese: , Isobe, English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found just inside the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.
Ictus Infestation is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Prospectors and the primary destination is Cauldros.

Ilithios, the Enlightened (Japanese: , Satori no Irisiosu) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Gularth family. It can be found at level 48 at Sunset Falls in Cauldros as long as the weather is not brimstone rain.
Illogical Etchings (Japanese: , Asayake no Fujōri) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Imposter Bugs (Japanese: , Noponmenkamemushi) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Iguaris (Japanese: , Iguarī) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.

Intelligent Liquid Metals (Japanese: , Jōhōtai Rikiddo Metaru) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular around Shivering Sands, West Ciel Sandsea, or in west Sylvalum Waters at night. Eight are needed for Juicy Analysis.

Iron Akebi Fruits (Japanese: , Tekkouakebi) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros. They appear rarely on the east side of Cauldros around the Kw'arah Cloister, FN Site 514, and FN Site 515, as well as in Cauldros Waters east of this area. Three are needed for A New Flavor.

The Infernal Ledges (Japanese: , Ganshō no Shin'en, Reef Ravine) are an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a series of four caves located north of Drongo Caravan in Cauldros. The entrance can be found by descending a sloped path down to the lava level where Calore, the Lava Walker stands. The caves themselves can be difficult to navigate as the only ground is distinct platforms; they must be jumped between carefully. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("Finding the Infernal Ledges").
